title: Line sketch: Swirling Tresses of Fire
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: Close-up portrait of a confident woman with voluminous, swirling hair in vibrant and tones against a solid background. The image uses flat color blocks with minimal shading and dynamic flowing lines to emphasize movement and energy (derived from painting #115).
